messages:
Maya: Heads-up — enterprise customer reported invoice much higher than their SDK token estimates for streaming chat with tools enabled. They sent invoice lines showing ~4.7k billed tokens vs SDK estimate ~2.0k. Need help reproducing and triaging.

Maya: Customer id: cust-5512, example invoice id: inv_2026_5512_06_11. They used SDK 1.3.2 with streaming ChatSession + tool-calls.

TJ: Can you paste a minimal repro payload and the SDK estimate vs API usage that they observed? Also any request_id from the invoice time window.

Maya: SDK reported: prompt_tokens=1200, completion_tokens=800 (total 2000). Invoice shows total billed tokens=4700. Customer captured the raw streaming logs and the API response usage is odd: the API response usage object shows prompt:1200, completion:800 but billing lines attribute ~3500 extra tokens to a label called "aux_tokens" (not normally seen).

Maya: Repro payload they used (redacted):
```json
POST /v1/chat/stream
{
  "model":"open-llm-quant",
  "messages":[{"role":"system","content":"sys: standard"},{"role":"user","content":"Please run my tool"}],
  "tools":[{"name":"diagnostics","input":"/run full-dump"}]
  "stream": true
}
```
They said SDK estimator code is the local client estimator in JS (estimator v0.9) which counts tokens of user+assistant content but explicitly ignores tool metadata fields.

Danielle: Do we have a request_id or runtime trace around the invoice timestamp? I can look for any runtime-side concatenation steps.

Maya: Yes — request_id: r-0a1b2c3d4e. I pulled a runtime log snippet from our side: `2026-06-11T14:02:33Z request=r-0a1b2c3d4e stage=postprocess token_count=2000 invoice_count=4700 note=aux_tokens=3500`

infra-bot: Trace created for r-0a1b2c3d4e: link: https://internal.traces/s/trace/r-0a1b2c3d4e (auto-attached).

Lex: I saw a similar discrepancy last month. Suspect the KV-prefill / tool metadata path: runtime can attach tool outputs (including debugging metadata) to the assistant completion for audit logs. If that attachment isn't stripped before we compute the metering tokenization for billing, it will inflate billed tokens. Can you check the token-breakdown debug from the runtime?

Mara: Minimal reproducer I ran locally: same model, call a tool that returns a JSON payload with a "diagnostic" field ~1500 tokens (lots of verbose metadata). With streaming, SDK estimator stayed ~2k but the runtime token-metering debug showed an additional 1.6k attributed to "tool_audit_blob" when computing invoice tokens. Reproducer snippet: 
```json
{"tool_result": {"diagnostic":"<~1500 token text here>", "meta":{"traces": ...}}}
```

Maya: Customer ran the repro and attached our metering debug response (we returned a `metering_token_breakdown` object in debug mode):
```
{ prompt_tokens: 1200, completion_tokens: 800, aux_tokens: 3500, aux_tags: ["system_preamble:kv_metadata","tool_audit_blob"] }
```
They also included the invoice line that showed a separate line item labeled "auxiliary metadata".

Billing-Eng: Do we have mapping from meter pipeline to invoice line labels? Aux_tags like "tool_audit_blob" shouldn't be billed as user-visible completions. Need to confirm whether those tokens were counted by the canonicalization step used by the billing job.

Danielle: I pulled the runtime postprocess code. There's a fallback branch where we build an "audit_completion" by concatenating assistant.text + tool_result.serialized for audit logs. A bug in the new audit-attachment change (merged in runtime v0.9.9) caused the audit blob to be passed into the billing tokenizer instead of the cleaned assistant text. Patch is small: strip tool_result.metadata and audit-only fields before tokenization. I've got a PR in review.

TJ: Can you run the debug tokenization endpoint for r-0a1b2c3d4e? Use X-Debug: true header, it will return the tokenized chunks. Command: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -H "X-Debug: true" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/debug/tokenize?r=r-0a1b2c3d4e`

Maya: Ran it. Response: `tokenized_chunks: ["<prompt...>", "<assistant: actual response>", "<kv: user-visible cache metadata>", "<tool_audit_blob: lots of base64/meta>"]` and the meter summed all chunks. Local SDK estimator only counted the first two chunks. So that's the delta.

Lex: Repro root cause confirmed: billing path was consuming audit-only attachments for token counts. The patch will prune those blobs. I'll add a unit test to ensure we never bill for chunks marked audit-only.

Billing-Eng: For mitigation: we will queue a credit for cust-5512 for the affected invoice range (2026-06-10 to 2026-06-12) and run a scan for other invoices that crossed the runtime version boundary. I'll coordinate the backfill.

Maya: Notified customer that we identified the issue and we're issuing a provisional credit. They asked for logs and repro steps which I attached. Thanks everyone :heart: 

Danielle: Patch merged to main, will roll to staging and then prod tomorrow 03:00 UTC; will run mass re-metering once deployed.

Billing-Eng: Will follow up with final credit amounts after re-metering. Leaving this thread open until backfill completes.

Maya: Closing loop: customer acknowledged the provisional credit and appreciated the quick turnaround.
